change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n27, n28, n29, n30, n31 and n32 (all native; none has run; n33 stays for cycle 9). Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `f31ea2b` (2026-11-16; cycle 7 found none); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-6/ref-shot.ts` in the main checkout shoots a page at 1440x1000 with reduced motion), and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 7 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-7/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools are in the same directory). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard frame, the list frame and the pointer sweep of cycle 7's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 7: (a) check v3-expr-7-kit-fixes before round 0: n26's error frame and n23's error at 390 (one titled message), n26 `?fixture=home` at 1800 and n21 at 390 (zone and rule labels clear the lines), n22's focus frame (each line keeps its hue), n24's loading against its rest (one height), n22 at 390 (ticks apart); if any did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (b) check v3-expr-7-contract: tell reviewers what the Spec ruled and which fields shipped; (c) check v3-expr-7-rubric: if its three sentences landed, the reviewer reads them from rubric.md; if not, tell reviewers the three readings the cycle-7 file records (X4 n/a where nothing responds and at most 2 without a sweep; a loading jump is K2 only; X3 n/a only when no list shows the chart's items or series); (d) run `make check-fast` before scoring round 0, and stop it by pid before builders start round 1 only if it is still queued for a slot; (e) tell reviewers what cycle 7's reviewer prompt says about the two sanctioned colour forms, the 61 px band and the LIST approach; (f) the keyboard-frame count is confounded: cycle 7's builder prompt names `shots.ts` as the shoot command, which has no keys state, and at least one builder said so; let the builder prompt say to shoot as the skill says (or give shots.ts a keys state, named in the cycle file), then count who shot a keyboard frame (cycles 5 to 7: 0 of 6 each); (g) `demo/series.ts` is shared: tell builders to change only their own group with one Edit after a fresh Read and never to rewrite the file (a rewrite deleted three groups in cycle 7's round 1), and to run `bun test` on its own, not at the end of a compound command (it gets wrapped into a host test slot whole); (h) once this cycle runs, the bank's only never-run cases are n33 and the ones it adds: add at least five from pages no case covers yet, so cycle 9 can draw six, and say so; (i) report every score on all items and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone, as cycles 3 to 7 do.
